chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Barqī, from ʿUmar ibn Yazīd, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: What is permitted to a man from a menstruating woman? He said: What is between her buttocks, but he must not penetrate.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man or husband asking about what is lawful for him
key_terms.مَا بَيْنَ أَلْيَتَيْهَا: the area between her buttocks, mentioned here in the legal response

ai.seo_question: What is permitted between a man and his wife when she is menstruating according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling about what is permitted in intimacy with a menstruating wife. It indicates permissibility of certain forms of sexual contact while explicitly prohibiting penetration.
